name: Margoz
summary: In northern Durotar, Margoz watches for the Burning Blade's growing threat. After the clash with fel corruption at Thunder Ridge, Orgnil Soulscar sends champions to seek the isolated orc shaman before they strike a nearby cultist stronghold. Margoz's counsel reveals Skull Rock, the Burning Blade's concealed cavern base.

sections.title: A Hermit's Vigil
sections.body: After Thunder Ridge revealed the depth of fel taint, Orgnil Soulscar sees that strength alone cannot cleanse Durotar. He sends champions to Margoz, an experienced orc shaman keeping a lonely camp in the crags northeast of Razor Hill. Between Drygulch Ravine and the eastern sea, Margoz watches the northern reaches for dark omens that Orgrimmar's busy warriors often miss.

sections.title: The Threat of Skull Rock
sections.body: Margoz knows the Burning Blade's power base in northern Durotar: Skull Rock, a concealed cavern system carved into the mountain cliffs outside Orgrimmar's southern gates. The cultists are closer to Thrall's capital than the Warchief's guards realize, and Skull Rock's hidden passages can conceal a demonic ambush. Margoz gives those sent against the coven counsel so they do not enter blindly.

faq.answer: Margoz is an experienced orc shaman loyal to the Horde, keeping a secluded camp in northeastern Durotar. He studies dark magic and watches the demonic corruption spreading through the region.
You can find Margoz at his camp in the rugged hills of northeastern Durotar, between Drygulch Ravine and the eastern coastline, southeast of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil Soulscar send me to Margoz?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar sends you to Margoz because the shaman has studied the local Burning Blade cultists. Before you assault their stronghold, Orgnil wants you to receive Margoz's spiritual wisdom and practical counsel.

Skull Rock is a concealed system of mountain caves just south of Orgrimmar's eastern walls. It is a fortified Burning Blade coven where demon-worshiping cultists conduct rituals close to the Horde's capital.
When you report to Margoz, he acknowledges your growing strength and sends you into Skull Rock to slay the cultists and recover their corrupted insignia.

faq.q: Is Margoz part of the Burning Blade?
faq.answer: No. Margoz is a devoted Horde shaman who works to purge demonic influence and keep young champions on an honorable, uncorrupted path.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see Margoz's patient wisdom in his watch on the wilderness margins, where he senses spiritual corruption before it becomes war.
As a member of the Horde, you can hear Margoz's warning: demon cults lurk within striking distance of Orgrimmar.
As an orc, meeting Margoz reminds you of fel power's lingering temptation and urges the new generation toward a pure, honorable path.
